meta.name: base: KYC signer rotation ROLLBACK
meta.description:
KasuAllowList.setNexeraIDSigner(0x29A75f22AC9A7303Abb86ce521Bb44C4C69028A0)

ROLLBACK ONLY — undoes the matching *-kyc-signer-rotate.json batch by restoring the
previous signer (current on-chain signer (pre-rotation state)).

  Allow list:      0x807A7e119EBf0282420b5Ca0e0056c0525cBf8BB
  Signer restored: 0x29A75f22AC9A7303Abb86ce521Bb44C4C69028A0

Executing this re-breaks any signature minted against KasuKycSigner, so the frontends must
be moved back onto the old signer path in the same window.
